MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper fits my recent fastener purchases because I could use it to check screw diameters and match washers to the right sizes.",
    "A practical measuring tool connects to my hardware needs when it helps me use the screws and washers I already have."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The feeler gauge and thermal camera serve specific inspection tasks that my recent purchases do not suggest I need.",
    "The #10-24 tap kit is related to fastening, but my recent screw assortment is metric and I have no stated need to cut that thread.",
    "The vacuum, soap dispenser, gloves, COVID test, alcohol and water meters do not help with my current fastening or storage needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat tools and practical supplies as broadly interchangeable, even though each solves a different problem.",
    "Buying magnetic hooks does not mean I currently need unrelated household equipment or maintenance supplies."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases cluster around magnetic hanging, organizing and assorted fasteners; useful next choices should support those tasks.",
    "Compatibility matters: my screws are metric, and a tool is relevant when it helps me identify or fit those parts.",
    "I rarely interact unless something addresses a concrete need, so a possible use someday is not enough for me to choose it now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my hardware interests but mostly missed the specific fastening and organizing tasks behind them."
}
